_comment: Monsters of which their maps hold a single one at a time (Managers.UniqueMonsters).
ordinary         who it is swapped for wherever the groups have it: the background groups of the
base and those drawn on the fly bring it two and three times over
maps             the maps where it stands, in one of their groups chosen at random
respawnMinutes   how long it stays away once beaten (0: it is back with the next map loaded)
LORD CROW'S LIBRARY, as Ankama remade it on 21 January 2025: «le but est de trouver 3 monstres
uniques qui se cachent parmi les 16 salles du donjon [...] Chaque monstre n'est présent qu'en un
seul exemplaire dans le donjon. S'il est en combat, il faut donc attendre qu'il repop. Si vous avez
de la chance, les 3 monstres uniques seront dans le même groupe» (Dofus pour les noobs). The
sixteen rooms are the client's subarea 1038, whose monsters are the three and the ordinary ones
they are a named version of. The guide gives no respawn time: INFERRED, back at once, so that
«attendre qu'il repop» is only the wait for the fight that holds it. The Master's companions in
his throne room are the same three (the guide again); a dungeon room's composed group is not

uniques.why: Zorio, el Zorrowapo (Rono le Renarbo), a Zorrowapo's (Renarbo's) named version; the library's sixteen rooms.
Horacio, el Cuerbok Domesticado (Horace le Corbac Apprivoisé), a Cuerbok domesticado's named version; the library's sixteen rooms.
Kondonio, el Bebedor (Kapotie le Buveur), a Bebedor's (Buveur's) named version; the library's sixteen rooms.
